protocol.task_selection: 24 most frequent nonempty instructions; GR1 all 24 task datasets
protocol.scope: Training-demonstration descriptive diagnostic, not held-out or contact ground truth.
protocol.sigma: masked mean softplus(s_raw + checkpoint ht_sbias) + 1e-3; all valid channels

calibration_holdout: Per-task disjoint episode split, 2/3 calibration, 1/3 test; not policy holdout.
covariance_protocol: Fixed calibration second-moment whitening, 5% offdiagonal shrinkage; not joint Student-t covariance EM.
